content:
carmen: New customer hit onboarding friction — followed the Go quickstart from the repo, exported REDWOOD_KEY, first request got 402 even though UI shows 'Trial enabled'. Anyone seen a race like this?

bjorn: Was the org created by SSO or invite? SSO sometimes flips UI state before backend billing is done.

carmen: SSO (Okta). The sample is the go-starter main branch. Minimal curl attached.

carmen: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace payment required","billing_url":"https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/org-abc/billing"}}
```

devx: Can you GET /v1/workspaces/me and paste the state?

carmen: GET /v1/workspaces/me returns state: "provisioning" despite frontend showing trial credit active.

bjorn: Yep this is the provisioning race. Frontend trusts the SSO callback and shows onboarding done, but provisioning job that wires billing/trials is async and can take ~30-120s. API gates until that job finishes.

carmen: Two extra odd things: (1) our sample's config loader picks up a stale key at ~/.config/redwood/config.json if present, so users think they set env but sample uses old key — caused confusion. (2) The Go SDK default retry policy retries 4 times on 4xx/5xx in starter, which caused the sample to spam 402s and flood the UI logs.

bjorn: Oof. For (1) we should change the sample to prefer env var over config file and log which key it's using (masked). For (2) SDK should not retry on 4xx billing_required. We already have an open task to treat 4xx as non-retryable except transient auth errors.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-99 created: onboarding/provisioning-race-and-retry-loop  https://go.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-99

devx: Short term fixes: (A) quickstart: do a preflight GET /v1/workspaces/me and wait for state=="active" with a short spinner and explanatory text; (B) change sample config precedence to env > file; (C) update starter to set SDK retry policy to not retry on billing_required. I'll open three PRs.

carmen: I'll take the env precedence fix and a log line showing key source. Happy to include a flag to skip preflight for CI.

starter-bot: PR opened: redwood-inference/starter#623  "go: prefer REDWOOD_KEY env over config file + log key source"

bjorn: Filed SDK issue: SDK-481 "Do not retry on billing_required (402) and surface clear error". We'll include a helper wait_for_workspace_ready in the SDK so quickstarts can call it.

carmen: After adding the preflight wait, the quickstart now waits ~45s and then first POST succeeds. I'll link the repro and the fixes to the incident. Closing loop unless it resurfaces. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
